data.gender_notes: Kaylil is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Kaion', meaning 'rejoicing'. In Greek mythology, Kaion was a god of joy and happiness. The name Kaylil carries the meaning “Rejoicing” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kaylil usually hope their child will grow to embody rejoicing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes joy and happiness in one's spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Kaylil belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rejoicing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kaylil total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

Furthermore, the name can serve as a reminder of the importance of joy and happiness in our daily lives.

It can serve as a reminder of the joy and happiness that comes from a personal relationship with God. Additionally, the name could represent the joy that comes from living a life according to God's will. Through the name Kaylil, a child may be inspired to strive for joy and happiness, not just in worldly things, but also in their spiritual walk.
